checks: Use the installation and warning chronology to choose a past impossibility deduction rather than a weaker possibility or obligation statement. Independent blind solve and item-level English, Traditional Chinese, answer and each distractor verified after language corrections. Post-submission vocabulary and usage notes were independently checked against the unchanged item and canonical schema.

activeQuestion.prompt: Version 2 of the monitoring software was not installed on this device until noon. The device generated the warning locally at 9 a.m., while version 1 was still running, so version 2 ____ the morning warning.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 這部裝置到中午才安裝第 2 版監控軟體。上午 9 點，裝置仍執行第 1 版，並在本機產生了警告。因此，上午的警告____由第 2 版引發。

options.whyZh: 第 2 版安裝時間晚於當時的警告，不能視為那次警告的可能來源。
當時執行的是第 1 版；不能據此斷定尚未安裝的第 2 版引發警告。
上午 9 點的警告由這部裝置在本機產生；當時仍執行第 1 版，第 2 版中午才安裝，因此不可能由第 2 版引發。
此處不是依設計預測當時應出現的警告，而是依已知時間排除不可能的原因。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 上午 9 點的警告由這部裝置在本機產生；當時仍執行第 1 版，第 2 版中午才安裝，因此不可能由第 2 版引發。
activeQuestion.evidence: not installed on this device until noon […] generated the warning locally at 9 a.m., while version 1 was still running

vocabulary.note: 持續追蹤設備狀態的程式，可在偵測到異常時發出警告。

originalQuestion.prompt: The replacement battery must be compatible ____ the existing charging circuit.
originalQuestion.promptZh: 替換電池必須____現有充電電路相容。

options.whyZh: from 不符合 compatible 的此處搭配。
be compatible with 為「與……相容」的固定搭配。
compatible at 不表示與某電路相容。
此處標準搭配為 compatible with，不用 to。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: be compatible with 為「與……相容」的固定搭配。
originalQuestion.evidence: compatible with the existing charging circuit

vocabulary.note: 能與既有設備或系統配合使用。
